notes: Official Telangana tourism site (telanganatourism.gov.in) blocked direct access; tgtdc.in redirected to Tripura. Data compiled from Wikipedia Tourism in Telangana article, trawell.in (82 destinations), holidify.com (30 destinations), and fabhotels.com (46 destinations).

destinations.name: Hyderabad
destinations.description: State capital, placed 2nd in Traveler Magazine's best places to see in the world in 2015. Home to Charminar, Golconda Fort, Ramoji Film City, Hussain Sagar Lake, and Irani Cafes.

destinations.name: Charminar
destinations.description: Built in 1591 CE, iconic monument and mosque with four ornate minarets. Global icon of Hyderabad, tallest structure in the city for nearly 400 years.

destinations.name: Golconda Fort
destinations.description: One of the most magnificent fortress complexes in India. Famous for housing the Koh-i-Noor and Hope diamonds.

destinations.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
destinations.description: Tombs dedicated to rulers of the Qutub Shahi dynasty near Golconda Fort. Example of Deccan architecture with large minarets and huge domes.

destinations.name: Chowmahalla Palace
destinations.description: 18th-century palace complex with UNESCO recognition, seat of the Asaf Jahi dynasty.

destinations.name: Taj Falaknuma Palace
destinations.description: Built by an Englishman, features a ceiling replica of Windsor Castle. Now a luxury heritage hotel.

destinations.name: Ramoji Film City
destinations.description: Largest integrated film city in the world with theme parks, gardens, and hotels.

destinations.name: Salarjung Museum
destinations.description: One of India's largest museums with rare art collections from around the world.

destinations.name: Birla Mandir, Hyderabad
destinations.description: Built on a 280-feet high hillock called Naubath Pahad on 13 acres in Hyderabad.

destinations.name: Mecca Masjid
destinations.description: One of the oldest and largest mosques in India, near Charminar. Bricks made from soil brought from Mecca.

destinations.name: Nehru Zoological Park
destinations.description: Houses over 1500 species and offers wildlife safaris.

destinations.name: KBR National Park
destinations.description: World-famous park in Jubilee Hills with diverse flora and fauna.

destinations.name: Mrugavani National Park
destinations.description: Popular weekend destination near Chilkur in Hyderabad.

destinations.name: Paigah Tombs
destinations.description: Recently discovered series of mausoleums with unique geometrical sculptures at Chandrayanagutta.

destinations.name: Spanish Mosque (Paigah Mosque)
destinations.description: Early 20th-century mosque in Begumpet with Andalusi/Spanish architecture, built by Paigah Nawab in 1906.

destinations.name: Wonderla Amusement Park
destinations.description: One of the biggest amusement parks in Hyderabad with many dry and water rides.

destinations.name: Shamirpet Lake
destinations.description: Artificial lake with deer sanctuary and boating facilities near Secunderabad.

destinations.name: Hussain Sagar Lake
destinations.description: Iconic heart-shaped lake in Hyderabad with a large Buddha statue in the center.

destinations.name: Warangal
destinations.description: Historical city known for 13th-century Warangal Fort built by the Kakatiya dynasty, Pakhal Lake, and Thousand Pillar Temple.

destinations.name: Kakatiya Kala Thoranam
destinations.description: Historical arch and symbol of the Kakatiya Dynasty in Warangal, built around 1200 CE. Forms the main symbol in the Emblem of Telangana.

destinations.name: Thousand Pillar Temple
destinations.description: One of the oldest temples of South India built by King Rudra Deva in 1163 AD. Specimen of Kakatiyan architecture with 1000 pillars.

destinations.name: Ramappa Temple
destinations.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site built in 1213 CE by General Recherla Rudra during the Kakatiya period. Praised as 'Brightest Star in Galaxy of Temples'.

destinations.name: Laknavaram Lake
destinations.description: Man-made lake near Govindaraopet, 80 km from Warangal, spread over 1000 acres.

destinations.name: Secunderabad
destinations.description: Twin city of Hyderabad with Clock Tower and Shamirpet Lake.

destinations.name: Nagarjuna Sagar
destinations.description: Home to one of the world's largest masonry dams (407 feet tall) on Krishna River with wildlife sanctuary and Ethipothala Waterfalls.

destinations.name: Yadagirigutta
destinations.description: Temple town with Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple (Pancha Narasimha Kshetram) in Nalgonda District.

destinations.name: Basara
destinations.description: Scenic town on Godavari River with rare Gnana Saraswati Temple (Goddess of Knowledge) in Adilabad District.

destinations.name: Bhadrachalam
destinations.description: Temple town with Sri Sitaramachandra Swamy Temple on the banks of River Godavari. Famous for Sri Rama Navami celebrations.

destinations.name: Vemulawada
destinations.description: Known as 'Dakshina Kasi' (Southern Banaras). Features Sri Raja Rajeshwara Temple built by Chalukya Kings (AD 750-975).

destinations.name: Alampur
destinations.description: Surrounded by Nallamala Hills with 7th-century Navabrahma Temples.

destinations.name: Kulpakji (Kolanupaka)
destinations.description: 2,000-year-old Jain Temple in Nalgonda district. One of the oldest temples in South India with a 130 cm jade statue of Lord Mahaveer.

destinations.name: Chilkur Balaji Temple
destinations.description: Known as 'VISA Temple' located on Osman Sagar Lake banks near Hyderabad.

destinations.name: Kondagattu Anjaneya Swamy Temple
destinations.description: Famous Hanuman temple in Karimnagar district.

destinations.name: Keesara Gutta
destinations.description: Temple complex near Hyderabad.

destinations.name: Sri Rama Chandra Swamy Temple, Ammapalli
destinations.description: 700-year-old temple near Hyderabad, also used for film shoots.

destinations.name: Edupayala Vana Durga Bhavani Temple
destinations.description: Temple dedicated to Goddess Durga in Medak district.

destinations.name: Wargal Saraswati Temple
destinations.description: Hilltop temple dedicated to Goddess Saraswati with unique shadow effect.

destinations.name: Kaleshwaram
destinations.description: Temple town at the confluence of rivers Godavari and Pranhita.

destinations.name: Dharmapuri
destinations.description: Temple town known for Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple on the banks of the Godavari.

destinations.name: Koti Lingala
destinations.description: Hindu pilgrimage site on Godavari river banks in Jagtial district.

destinations.name: Chaya Someshwara Temple, Panagal
destinations.description: 11th-century temple with unique shadow phenomenon.

destinations.name: Sri Lalitha Someswara Swamy Temple, Somasila
destinations.description: 7th-century temple complex with 15 temples.

destinations.name: Kuchadri Venkateshwara Swamy Temple
destinations.description: Ancient Hindu temple in Kuchanpally, Medak District.

destinations.name: Nelakondapalli
destinations.description: Famous for Bhakta Ramadasu's birthplace and South India's biggest Buddha Stupa from 3rd century BC.

destinations.name: Medak Cathedral (Church of South India)
destinations.description: Largest church in Telangana, consecrated 1924. Gothic Revival with six-colored mosaic tiles imported from Britain. Largest diocese in Asia.

destinations.name: Medaram
destinations.description: Small village known for vibrant Sammakka Saralamma Jatara festival, one of the largest tribal gatherings in the world.

destinations.name: Badapahad Dargah (Peddagutta)
destinations.description: One of the oldest Muslim Pilgrim Centers, built in memory of saint Syed Sadullah Hussain in Nizamabad District.

destinations.name: Bhongir Fort
destinations.description: 10th-century fort on isolated monolithic rock, 800 meters altitude. Unique egg-shaped construction built by Western Chalukya ruler. Associated with Queen Rudramadevi.

destinations.name: Devarakonda Fort
destinations.description: 13th-14th century fort with temples to Rama and Shiva.

destinations.name: Rachakonda Fort
destinations.description: 1360 AD Kakatiya dynasty fort offering 360-degree views with Dasavatara sculptures.

destinations.name: Medak Fort
destinations.description: 12th-century fort 96 km from Hyderabad, mostly in ruins but architecturally significant.

destinations.name: Gadwal Fort
destinations.description: 17th-century fort with 32-feet cannon and three temples.

destinations.name: Koilkonda Fort
destinations.description: 16th-century fort with seven gates surrounded by forest streams.

destinations.name: Domakonda Fort
destinations.description: 18th-century fort with high arches and glass-work palace in Nizamabad district.

destinations.name: Nagunur Fort and Temples
destinations.description: 7th-century site ruled by Chalukyas and Kakatiyas in Karimnagar district.

destinations.name: Elgandal Fort
destinations.description: 16th-century stronghold in Karimnagar with Charminar replica and oscillating minaret.

destinations.name: Ramagiri Fort
destinations.description: Stone fort atop hills with cannons and medicinal plants in Karimnagar district.

destinations.name: Molangur Fort
destinations.description: Historical fort in Nalgonda district.

destinations.name: Jagtial Fort
destinations.description: European-style castle with four inbuilt ponds and cannons.

destinations.name: Chandraghad Fort
destinations.description: Historical fort in Karimnagar district.

destinations.name: Khilla Ghanpur (Ghanpur Fort)
destinations.description: Historical fort near Warangal.

destinations.name: Kuntala Waterfall
destinations.description: Highest waterfall in Telangana at 45 metres (148 ft) in Adilabad district, in the Sahyadri Mountains.

destinations.name: Bogatha Waterfall
destinations.description: Called 'Niagara of Telangana', second-largest waterfall in the state, located in Mulugu district, 120 km from Bhadrachalam.

destinations.name: Mallela Theertham
destinations.description: 150-feet charming waterfall in the dense Nallamala Forest, 173 km from Hyderabad.

destinations.name: Pochera Falls
destinations.description: Waterfall on the Kadam River, 22 km from Kuntala Falls in Adilabad district.

destinations.name: Gayatri Waterfalls
destinations.description: Cascading waterfall over River Kadem in Adilabad district.

destinations.name: Ethipothala Waterfalls
destinations.description: Waterfalls near Nagarjuna Sagar on the Krishna River.

destinations.name: Bheemuni Paadam Waterfalls
destinations.description: Picturesque waterfall at Gudur in Warangal District, 200 km from Hyderabad.

destinations.name: Kanakai Waterfalls
destinations.description: 30-foot cascade in Girnur village with pool at base in Adilabad district.

destinations.name: Ananthagiri Hills
destinations.description: Wildlife sanctuary and hill station 90 km from Hyderabad with Nagasamudram Lake.

destinations.name: Papikondalu
destinations.description: Mountain range along River Godavari with scenic hills and Gandi Pochamma Temple.

destinations.name: Amrabad Tiger Reserve
destinations.description: One of India's largest tiger reserves spanning 2,611 sq km in Nallamala Hills.

destinations.name: Eturnagaram Wildlife Sanctuary
destinations.description: Wildlife sanctuary in Mulugu district with diverse flora and fauna.

destinations.name: Kinnerasani Wildlife Sanctuary
destinations.description: 635 sq km sanctuary in Khammam district near Godavari River.

destinations.name: Singur Dam
destinations.description: Built on Manjira River, home to crocodiles and migratory birds.

destinations.name: Jurala Dam
destinations.description: 1045-feet tall hydroelectric project with deer park.

destinations.name: Koilsagar Dam
destinations.description: Irrigation center with camping, rappelling, and fishing facilities.

destinations.name: Sriram Sagar Dam
destinations.description: One of the largest water projects on Godavari River in Nizamabad district.

destinations.name: Nizam Sagar Dam
destinations.description: Historic 1923 dam visited by Nehru and Gandhi, popular picnic spot.

destinations.name: Adilabad
destinations.description: Land of waterfalls and one of the most scenic regions in Telangana with dense forest, beautiful valleys and several rivers. Includes Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary.

destinations.name: Karimnagar
destinations.description: City 164 km from Hyderabad showcasing Telugu and Persian architecture.

destinations.name: Khammam
destinations.description: Fourth-largest city with Narsimha Swami Temple, Khammam Fort, Lakaram Lake Park, and Kinnerasani Dam.

destinations.name: Nizamabad
destinations.description: Third-largest city, 'City of Nizams', featuring 10th-century fort, Pocharam Wildlife Sanctuary, and Nizamsagar.

destinations.name: Nalgonda
destinations.description: Historically rich city with Paleolithic Age evidence and cultural heritage.

destinations.name: Mahabubnagar
destinations.description: Features Koilsagar Dam, Rajolibanda Dam, and 7th-century Jain Temple on western border.

destinations.name: Nirmal
destinations.description: Famous for its traditional handicrafts and Nirmal paintings.

destinations.name: Kollapur
destinations.description: Late 19th-century riverside palace with Gothic architecture.

destinations.name: Dhulikatta
destinations.description: Ancient Buddhist centre with archaeological significance.

destinations.name: Phanigiri
destinations.description: Buddhist archaeological site with ancient stupas and monasteries.

destinations.name: Mudumal Megalithic Menhirs
destinations.description: Megalithic menhir site in Narayanapet, Telangana.

destinations.name: Somasila
destinations.description: Temple town with 7th-century Lalitha Someswara Swamy Temple and eco-tourism project.
